technique_name: Compose a persuasive speech about the importance of recycling.
description: Good morning everyone! Today, I am here to motivate you to take action in the fight for our planet: recycling. In our world today, plastic waste is overflowing into our oceans and landfills, and it is damaging our environment and wildlife. Even worse, it is setting us up for future catastrophes like floods, droughts and famine.
